annotations.title: Can this employer sponsor a work visa? (UK register and US filings)

description: Can this employer sponsor a work visa? (UK register and US filings). For "does Deliveroo sponsor visas?", "can this company sponsor a Skilled Worker visa?", "does Walmart sponsor H-1B?". Looks the employer up in the UK Home Office register of licensed sponsors (workers), with its town and the visa routes it is licensed for, and in US Department of Labor work visa filings (H-1B, H-1B1, E-3: certified filings, median offered pay, states). Trading names and brand names work for most large employers. found is false only when neither has it. A licence or past filings mean the employer can sponsor; each job still has to qualify. Register data contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0; US filings are public domain. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

company.description: The employer, for example "Tesco" or its legal name "Tesco Stores Limited".

country.description: Optional: UK or US to check one country only. Leave out to check both.
